scenario: Component access after `.utc` per LTIM.6.1: `m.fired_at.utc.hour` is valid, because the `.utc` member establishes UTC timezone context, and the read lowers to FN_HOUR (LTIM.6.5). Pin: a where clause using `m.fired_at.utc.hour` twice compiles cleanly. Compile-only: logical/LTIM.6.5_utc_hour_gate pins what the read evaluates to.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule business_hours:
    Event m where m.fired_at.utc.hour > 8 and m.fired_at.utc.hour < 17
->
    log info "business hours event"
